case_plans.title: McDonald’s — McHappy Day
case_plans.card_summary: A fundraising campaign that led people from a mobile character builder to registration and giving.
case_plans.task: Give a seasonal fundraising campaign a clear path from attention to registration and giving.
case_plans.role: Digital strategy, concept and messaging; scripts, banners, social copy, voiceovers and campaign coordination through the agency context.

stages.title: Map the action
stages.text: Connected paid social, website and CRM around one participation journey.

stages.title: Build the message
stages.text: Developed the campaign concept and copy, with channel-specific creative and production direction.

stages.title: Carry it through delivery
stages.text: Coordinated production partners and channel delivery across paid social, web and CRM.

case_plans.result: McHappy Day recorded 200K registrations, $230K+ in donations and +20% year-on-year social-audience growth.
case_plans.scope_note: Campaign-wide reported outcomes across the fundraising journey.

case_plans.title: McDonald’s — Product Campaigns
case_plans.card_summary: Original and localized product campaigns for social, outdoor, packaging and restaurants.
case_plans.task: Give each menu or restaurant promotion a recognizable idea that would still work across different placements.
case_plans.role: Developed concepts and scripts, wrote copy, recorded voiceovers and coordinated creative across the agency, client and production partners.

stages.title: Create and localize
stages.text: Developed some campaigns from scratch and adapted others for the local market. Wrote channel copy and scripts and helped adapt video creative across languages.

stages.title: Take the message into the restaurant
stages.text: Worked across social, outdoor, packaging and in-restaurant communications. The gallery shows a chicken campaign, a packaging activation and a restaurant launch concept.

stages.title: Run campaigns in parallel
stages.text: Coordinated creative across up to three active campaigns in peak weeks.

case_plans.result: A collection of product, packaging and restaurant launch work.
case_plans.scope_note: Agency work for McDonald’s. The gallery includes portfolio adaptations. McHappy Day’s fundraising results are reported separately.

case_plans.title: SCREAM 7 — Paramount Pictures × Complex Art Competition
case_plans.card_summary: A five-work poster series; “IN PROGRESS” selected for the official Complex Los Angeles exhibition.
case_plans.task: Create key art for the SCREAM 7 competition that fans would recognize before they saw the title.
case_plans.role: Concept development, visual storytelling, art direction and design for an independent competition entry.

stages.title: Turn the mask into an idea
stages.text: Built five posters around familiar SCREAM motifs: the phone, surveillance, identity and the feeling of being watched. Created a five-work competition series with a common typographic treatment.

stages.title: Choose what the viewer sees first
stages.text: Made the mask emerge from a fog bank in one design. For IN PROGRESS, used a phone-list concept to turn the franchise’s recurring call into a threat before the viewer sees a face.

case_plans.result: Official competition winner; “IN PROGRESS” was selected for the Complex Los Angeles exhibition in February 2026.
case_plans.scope_note: Competition entry: one selected work from the original five-work series. Paramount and Complex identify the competition context.

case_plans.title: Cal Poly DxHub × AWS — EHS Mentor
case_plans.card_summary: I designed and built a safety-training prototype that turns documents into assignments and lets administrators track completion.
case_plans.task: Give safety administrators a way to go from source documents and training requirements to course assignments and completion records in one place.
case_plans.role: Designed the full interface, set up servers and configured Amazon Bedrock. Built and presented a Python/FastAPI prototype.

stages.title: Design for administrators and learners
stages.text: Mapped who assigns courses, who completes them, and what each person needs to see. Designed the interface for assignments, progress reporting and administrative review.

stages.title: Set up the AI and server infrastructure
stages.text: Configured Amazon Bedrock and set up servers during the program. Built the app with Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker and Render.

stages.title: Connect documents to the training workflow
stages.text: Used Amazon Bedrock to extract training requirements from safety documents. Built screens to turn requirements into assignments and track completion. Screenshots show example data from the prototype.

case_plans.result: I presented a working prototype at the Cal Poly DxHub × AWS AI Summer Camp.
case_plans.scope_note: Prototype built during the program. I designed the interface, configured servers and Amazon Bedrock, and built the Python/FastAPI application. The public demo is a prototype, not a deployed compliance product.

case_plans.title: Community Work — Health Outreach, Youth Media and Refugee Storytelling
case_plans.card_summary: Public-health materials, youth media and first-person stories about rebuilding after displacement.
case_plans.task: Help people find useful health information, share what they have made, and tell stories in their own words.
case_plans.role: I made web and print materials, volunteered in health and youth programs, and shared my experience through interviews and community networks.

stages.title: Public-health materials and outreach
stages.text: At Vstrecha, a Global Fund partner in Belarus, I made public-health booklets, posters, web pages and annual reports. I also helped people find information on prevention and testing. This work ran from June 2007 to December 2014.

links.label: Read the background and press sources

visual.caption: Vstrecha community health research report, published with the Center for Independent Social Research and amfAR.

stages.title: Youth media and mentoring
stages.text: In separate BELAU and UNICEF contexts, I supported youth media, mentoring and volunteer initiatives. That work is separate from my health outreach and U.S. storytelling.

stages.title: Refugee storytelling in the U.S.
stages.text: I shared what it took to start over in the U.S. through interviews and practical information for newcomers. Human Rights First published my story. In September 2026 I joined the Refugee Storytellers Collective speaker pool for future opportunities; talks are agreed individually.

links.label: Read the Human Rights First profile

case_plans.result: Health information in print and online, youth media work, and published stories about rebuilding a creative life.
case_plans.scope_note: Vstrecha / Global Fund, BELAU / UNICEF and the U.S. storytelling organizations are separate contexts. StoryRise mentorship is in progress.

case_plans.task: Four briefs called for different opening shots, pacing and endings. Each clip shows the edit in motion.
case_plans.role: I developed concepts and edited the four pieces. Work included production coordination, type animation, captions and AI-assisted visuals.

stages.title: RentPrimeRoom
stages.text: Opened the rental ad with a pest-infested apartment, then cut to the couple arriving at a new place. I used AI-assisted scenes to make the before-and-after story legible in a short spot.

stages.title: ArtPeel
stages.text: Timed the product reveals, animated type and offer to guide the eye from what the product is to the promotion.

stages.title: Actor showreel
stages.text: Cut performance clips into a reel with split screens and animated type. The edits put the range of performances up front.

stages.title: Deep Rest
stages.text: Conceived the shoot, brought in a camera operator, and edited a vertical piece around an excerpt from Jim Carrey. I paced the shots to the speech and added captions.

case_plans.result: Watch each cut to see how the opening, type and pacing change with the brief.

case_plans.title: VERIFY YOU ARE HUMAN
case_plans.card_summary: A Pinocchio poster that turns a familiar verification screen into a question about being human.
case_plans.task: Reinterpret Pinocchio for an international poster exhibition marking 200 years since Carlo Collodi’s birth.
case_plans.role: Poster concept, art direction, typography and final artwork.

stages.title: Find a contemporary test
stages.text: Used the familiar “I’m human” checkbox to connect Pinocchio’s wish to become human with the way screens ask us to prove it.

stages.title: Put the metaphor in the image
stages.text: Paired a wooden hand and a lengthening nose with a smartphone, using the nose as the pointer for the verification screen.

case_plans.result: Selected for the international exhibition and catalogue.
case_plans.scope_note: Museo MAGMA’s selection notice named exhibitions in Italy, Argentina and Cuba and inclusion in the catalogue and archive. The international jury selected 200 posters from more than 500 submissions.
